hooks.logic:
Set the next state to 0.
Let part be part 1 of the enemy.
Let part2 be part 2 of the enemy.
If this state's '_isLaunchingPairAttack', then
  If not (part is alive and part can act and part2 is alive and part2 can act), then set this state's '_isLaunchingPairAttack' to false.
  If part is ready to act and part2 is ready to act, then
    Set the next state to 21.
    Set this state's '_isLaunchingPairAttack' to false.
  Stop.
If part is ready to act, then
  If util passes a fraction roll of the numeric entry "prob_for_pair_attack" in the battle settings of the enemy and part2 is alive and part2 can act, then set this state's '_isLaunchingPairAttack' to true and stop.
  Part picks and uses a weighted random move.
If part2 is ready to act, then part2 picks and uses a weighted random move.

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
If the current state is 12, then
  Change state to 11.
  Return true.
If the current state is not 22, then
  Let v be every part in (the parts of the acting enemy) where part is alive.
  Let len be the length of arg.
  Let globalRegister be the register of this state.
  If v and len is 2, then set globalRegister's 'dyingMessageSuffixNo' to "05".
  Otherwise, if v and len is 1, then
    If the value "no" of arg at 0 is 1, then set globalRegister's 'dyingMessageSuffixNo' to "01".
    Otherwise, set globalRegister's 'dyingMessageSuffixNo' to "03".
  Otherwise
    If v or len is not 1, then
      Let v2 be JSON → stringify with (["isAllAlive", v, "dyingNum", len]).
      Fail with new Error with ("unexpected notifyJudgedDeath. " plus v2).
    If the value "no" of arg at 0 is 1, then set globalRegister's 'dyingMessageSuffixNo' to "02".
    Otherwise, set globalRegister's 'dyingMessageSuffixNo' to "04".
  Change state to 22.
Return false.
